devotees.title: Finding & Registering Devotees (Global Devotee Search)
devotees.s1: On every form (Donation, Pledge, Seva Booking, Room, Hall, Prasad) the devotee field is a global search box
devotees.s2: Type a mobile number or name — matches across ALL temples appear with Verified ✓ and Connected 🔗 badges
devotees.s3: Select a match to attach the devotee; their PAN (if verified) flows onto the 80G receipt automatically
devotees.s4: Not found? Click "Register on-site": enter name + optional PAN, then "Send OTP"
devotees.s5: The devotee shares the 6-digit OTP from their phone; verifying links them to your temple and confirms identity
devotees.s6: PAN tip: tick "Don't share PAN" to skip it — the receipt then prints with name + mobile only
devotees.s7: Offline (desktop): the box becomes plain name + mobile inputs; the record auto-links by mobile when you reconnect

donation.title: Recording a Donation
donation.s2: Use the Donor search to find/register a devotee (see "Global Devotee Search" above)
donation.s3: For unnamed gifts choose "Anonymous / Gupt Dan", or "Dan Peti (Donation Box)" for collection-box cash
donation.s4: Select donation category and enter amount + payment mode
donation.s5: 80G eligibility is auto-checked (disabled for cash > ₹2000, and for anonymous gifts)
donation.s6: Save — receipt available via the Receipt icon (📄) in the list
donation.s7: To void a donation: click the 🚫 icon and enter a reason (admin only)

boli.title: Pledge (Boli) Management
boli.s1: Go to Donations → Pledges tab → New Pledge — use the Devotee search to attach a global devotee (or mark anonymous)
boli.s2: Enter the pledged amount; status will be "Pledged" until payment is recorded
boli.s3: When devotee pays: click the "Pay" button on the pledge entry
boli.s4: Enter amount and payment mode in the modal, then confirm
boli.s5: To waive remaining balance: click ⚠️ icon and enter a reason (admin only)
boli.s6: View intimation details via the 🔔 icon on any boli row

certificates.title: 80G Certificates & Form 10BD
certificates.s3: Click "Load Eligible Donors" to see 80G-eligible donations
certificates.s4: Click "Generate Form 10BD" to create IT-format entries
certificates.s5: Download compliance reports from the Download Compliance Files section
certificates.s6: Switch to TDS tab to view/export TDS deducted at source

rooms.title: Room Booking
rooms.s1: Go to Accommodation → Rooms → New Booking
rooms.s2: Select available room and enter guest details and dates
rooms.s4: Booking appears in the list with "Booked" status
rooms.s6: On departure: click "Check-Out"; to cancel: click ✕ icon

prasad.title: Prasad POS Counter
prasad.s1: Go to Prasad Counter — item grid shows all active items
prasad.s2: Click items to add to cart; use +/- to adjust quantity
prasad.s3: Cart shows subtotal, GST, and total automatically
prasad.s4: Select payment mode and click Checkout to record the sale
prasad.s5: Manage items via Prasad Counter → Manage Items (edit, adjust stock)

bhojanshala.title: Bhojanshala Tokens
bhojanshala.s1: Go to Bhojanshala page — select the date using the date picker
bhojanshala.s2: Click "Record Sale" to add a token sale (meal type, quantity, rate)
bhojanshala.s3: Summary cards show total tokens and collection for the day
bhojanshala.s4: To redeem tokens later: click "Redeem" on any sale row and enter quantity

seva.title: Seva (Pooja) Bookings
seva.s1: Go to Seva Booking → New Booking
seva.s2: Select seva type — amount fills automatically from the seva catalog
seva.s3: Use the Devotee search to attach a global devotee (or mark anonymous)
seva.s4: Enter gotra, sankalp names, and date (these stay separate from the devotee record)
seva.s5: Booking list shows status; mark "Done" after the pooja is completed

connectedDevotees.title: Connected Devotees
connectedDevotees.s1: Go to People → Connected Devotees to manage every devotee linked to your temple
connectedDevotees.s2: Three tabs: Connected (approved), Pending Requests (devotees who asked to join), Pending Invites (you invited)
connectedDevotees.s3: Approve / Reject pending requests; cancel a pending invite or remove a connected devotee
connectedDevotees.s4: Click "Invite Devotee", enter a 10-digit mobile — the devotee gets a notification in the JainERP™ Devotee app to accept
connectedDevotees.s5: Connected devotees can receive temple notices and appear pre-verified in your forms

staff.title: Staff & User Management
staff.s2: To invite a new staff member: enter mobile, name, and role, then click "Send Invite"
staff.s3: Staff receives an OTP on their mobile to log in
staff.s4: To update role or deactivate: click "Edit" on the staff row
staff.s5: Roles: Admin > Accountant > Cashier > Priest > Volunteer > Viewer

tally.title: Tally (TallyPrime)
tally.intro: Send this trust's books to your CA's TallyPrime, and bring the CA's ledgers, opening balances and adjustment entries back. Everything you send comes from the General Ledger, so Tally's trial balance matches JainERP's.
tally.companyHint: Leave empty for the company open in Tally
tally.browserNote: In the browser: download the file and import it in Tally, or upload a file Tally exported. The JainERP desktop app on the Tally PC can also send and read directly.

tally.howTitle: How to import the file in TallyPrime
tally.how1: Open the company in TallyPrime (its books must begin on or before the first date sent).
tally.how2: Gateway of Tally → Import → Masters: choose the downloaded file (ledgers first).
tally.how3: Then Import → Transactions with the same file for the vouchers.
tally.how4: Sending the same period again updates those vouchers in Tally instead of adding them twice.
tally.namesHint: Your CA may already have their own ledger names in Tally. Write them here once and every export uses them. Empty = JainERP's name (shown in grey).
tally.importHint: Nothing is changed until you confirm: first you see what would happen. JainERP's own entries are never brought back, and an entry is brought in only once.

tally.opt_openings_hint: Assets, liabilities and funds as one entry on the year's first day. Cash and bank openings are only compared.
